title: 🎭 LAMPOON SATIRICAL CREATOR CLAN
subtitle: Honor of Kings • Content Creator Community
description:
𝗟𝗔𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗖𝗹𝗮𝗻 is a content creator-focused Honor of Kings community dedicated to bringing together creators, players, partners, organizations, and communities through gaming content, community activities, promotions, and creative campaigns.

**Want to become part of 𝙻𝙰𝙼𝙿𝙾𝙾𝙽?**
Whether you are a Content Creator, Player, Community, Organization, Brand, or potential Partner, you may contact our team through the ticket system.

🎫 **Create a Ticket:** <#1538962265712369776>

Use the ticket channel for Partnership, Collaboration, Sponsorship, Creator opportunities, Community involvement, or other LAMPOON-related proposals.

partnership.title: 🤝 〔𝖯𝖠𝖱𝖳𝖭𝖤𝖱𝖲𝖧𝖨𝖯〕
partnership.content:
Build a long-term relationship with LAMPOON and its creator community.

**Potential Partnership Opportunities:**
⌑ Community & creator network partnerships
⌑ Honor of Kings-related projects
⌑ Long-term promotional campaigns
⌑ Creator network partnerships
⌑ Community events and activities
⌑ Cross-community partnerships
⌑ Exclusive partner campaigns
⌑ Mutual community promotion
⌑ Strategic gaming-community relationships

**Who can propose a partnership?**
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Gaming communities

Create a ticket in <#1538962265712369776> and provide your organization/community name, partnership proposal, objectives, expected involvement, and contact information.

**Best for:** Organizations, gaming communities, esports groups, brands, and projects seeking an ongoing relationship with LAMPOON.

sponsorship.title: 💰 〔SPONSORSHIP〕
sponsorship.content:

**Sponsorship Opportunities:**
⌑ Sponsored content
⌑ Event sponsorship
⌑ Tournament / competition sponsorship
⌑ Giveaway sponsorship
⌑ Product or service promotion
⌑ Creator sponsorship
⌑ Community campaign sponsorship
⌑ Sponsored announcements
⌑ Brand placement in approved promotional materials
⌑ Campaign support

**Potential Sponsors:**
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Gaming brands
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Businesses
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Esports organizations
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Gaming-related services
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Product and merchandise brands
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Event organizers
<a:Avisala:1542448826265243660> Technology and digital services

**Interested in sponsoring LAMPOON?**
Create a ticket in <#1538962265712369776> and provide your brand or organization name, sponsorship proposal, campaign objectives, available resources or budget, promotional expectations, and timeline.

All sponsorship proposals are subject to LAMPOON review and approval.

**Best for:** Brands and businesses looking for targeted exposure within the Honor of Kings and gaming-content audience.
